title: ts-client: runtime shape decoders and discriminator mappers for structured output
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: The TypeScript SDK currently emits loosely-typed objects for structured output and relies on consumer-side ad hoc parsing. This causes runtime crashes and diverging parsing logic across customers when models emit unions or polymorphic shapes in streaming and non-streaming responses.

Goal: Provide a small, ergonomic runtime library in the ts-client that: (1) decodes model output into well-typed discriminated unions at runtime, (2) offers Zod and JSON-Schema helper factories for common shape patterns, (3) supports streaming-friendly incremental decoding (token-by-token shape hints), and (4) includes clear examples and migration guide to keep backward compatibility.

Scope notes: This ticket covers design, codegen hooks (shape hints), runtime decoder implementation, Zod/JSON-schema adapter helpers, tests, performance benchmarks, and docs/examples. It intentionally does not include new server-side shape enforcement or model prompting changes (separate infra ticket).
acceptance_criteria: Runtime decoder API (decodeOutput) implemented and exported from ts-client runtime package
Discriminated union mapper utilities that accept a discriminator key and mapping registry
Zod adapter helpers: zodFromSchema(schemaShape) and zodFromDiscriminator(mapping) documented
JSON-Schema emitter for generated shape hints used by console examples
Streaming API supports incremental hints: examples show partial parse and final shape validation
Performance regression <= 8% median latency on common gen paths (bench results attached)
Unit and integration tests covering happy path, malformed tokens, missing discriminator, and fallback parsing
A short migration guide and 3 end-to-end examples in examples/ts-client/structured-output/*

comments: 2025-02-11 Asha Patel: Created ticket and initial problem statement. Linked to runtime and client teams for visibility.
2025-02-14 Liam Chen: Spike implemented for incremental parser prototype; results look promising — 5–7% median latency overhead in Node 20, improvements possible via fast-path for flat shapes.

2025-02-18 Design review: agreed on discriminator-first strategy to minimize speculative parsing. Decided NOT to enforce discriminator presence at the protocol layer; runtime will provide strict and permissive modes.
2025-02-21 Ramon Ortiz: Zod adapter PR started — initial API zodFromDiscriminator(mapping) returns a ZodUnion with lazy branches; needs ergonomics for streaming.
2025-02-24 Meena Gupta: Added two example prompts and expected structured outputs for chat-with-choices and reranking. Filed follow-up ticket ENG-352150 for example polishing.
2025-02-27 QA: Integration tests failing on partial tokens where discriminator arrives after body; added robust speculative buffer behavior to streamDecode.
